description: This file contains PHP code for populating and managing reports in the vtiger CRM system, including functions for creating report folders, inserting report details, modules, sorting, filters, and conditions into the database.

methods.name: PopulateReportFolder
methods.description: Stores a report folder name and description into the database.

methods.name: insertSelectQuery
methods.description: Creates a new select query entry in the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: insertSelectColumns
methods.description: Stores selected column names for a report query into the database.

methods.name: insertReports
methods.description: Stores report details such as name, description, type, and folder ID into the database.

methods.name: insertReportModules
methods.description: Stores primary and secondary modules associated with a report into the database.

methods.name: insertSortColumns
methods.description: Stores sorting order for report columns into the database.

methods.name: insertStdFilter
methods.description: Stores standard filter criteria for reports into the database.

methods.name: insertAdvFilter
methods.description: Stores advanced filter conditions for reports into the database.
